notes: Variant assumption is a seated pec-deck or machine chest fly with guided arms, pads, or handles. Visible roles are intentionally conservative: pectoralis major primary and anterior deltoid secondary. Triceps brachii was not included because the direct pec-deck evidence describes it as much less relevant than in pressing. Biceps brachii was not included because the strongest evidence for high biceps activation comes from dumbbell flyes with independent free weights, not a guided machine. Serratus anterior and rotator cuff were not included because exact machine fly evidence did not support a concise visible support classification. Local anatomy already maps Pectoralis major and Anterior deltoid, so no shared anatomy edit was needed. Main unresolved uncertainty is commercial machine geometry: forearm-pad pec deck versus handle fly, start-range stop, seat height, elbow angle, humeral rotation, and cam/resistance profile can shift pectoralis and anterior-deltoid emphasis.
